create_smpl_model: create an SMPL body model from a model path with configurable betas and pose parameters
create_smplh_model: create an SMPLH body model with hand pose PCA components and left and right hand joints
create_smplx_model: create an SMPLX expressive body model with face expression coefficients jaw and eye poses
forward_smpl_vertices: run the SMPL forward pass to compute mesh vertices and joints from pose and shape parameters
factory_create_model: use the create factory function to instantiate SMPL SMPLH or SMPLX models by type and path
